sinopsis.es: Celeste desaparece una noche de la casa de trata infantil donde vive. Su hermana la busca hasta meterse en problemas. Mientras se involucra en una conspiración de otra de las chicas para acabar con su captor, se da cuenta que Celeste no volverá.
sinopsis.en: Celeste disappears one night from the child trafficking house where she lives. Her sister searches for her until she gets into trouble. As she becomes involved in a conspiracy led by another girl to take down their captor, she realizes that Celeste will not return.
